For checker correspondence inspect the actual predicate, trigger, context/identity comparisons, allowed initial states, excluded branches and observed events. Can the antecedent occur? Does the scope contain the relevant event? Do not claim nonvacuity or behavioral equivalence without an executed check; state missing evidence and request discriminating material or exploration. The controller computes the actual semantic write set, including binding associations and unit scope. Declare every changed field with exact JSON before and after values in changes.
